rules.statement: A guardian ad litem's admission of a plaintiff's claim under Section 72 of the Civil Procedure Code does not constitute an adjustment within the meaning of Section 408, and thus does not require the court’s leave as per Section 500.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 500 of the Civil Procedure Code which debars a guardian of a minor from compounding an action without the leave of the Court refers to such an adjustment of an action as is mentioned in section 408 and is not applicable to an admission made by the guardian in terms of section 72."
